Subject: Adaptive inference playbook & qualification

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candidness on latency and cost pressure for your product search flow. High-level recap from our side and suggested next steps:

Pain points you described:
- Long tail of slow queries during peak (p99 spikes to ~1.2s per token) impacting CTR.
- Current embedding/rerank pipeline has significant token cost and inconsistent relevancy on short queries.
- Security requirement: all inference for personalization must run in your VPC and meet audit log retention requirements.

Goals you shared:
1) Reduce p99 generation latency by ~30% while keeping quality stable.
2) Cut per-query inferencing cost for rerank path by 25–40%.
3) Validate an on-prem or VPC deployment path that fits your procurement window.

Suggested technical fit and integration approach:
- SDK streaming + function-calling to move scoring out of long text outputs and into structured JSON (lower token spend, deterministic parsing).
- Hybrid rerank: local lightweight embed model for candidate filtering (cheap), Redwood hosted/dedicated for final rerank with KV prefix caching.
- Quantization profile recommendation: 8-bit for rerank model, FP16 for the generator path where we need higher fidelity.
- Private deployment option (VPC) to satisfy audit/KMS and retention controls.

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) I’ll share an "Adaptive Inference Playbook" (attached) with concrete SDK examples (streaming + function call snippets) and an integration checklist.
2) Ben will put together a rough cost/throughput estimate for your traffic profile.
3) Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive (we recommend joining your infra/security folks) — proposed dates in the Calendly link below.

Attachments: adaptive-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook + SDK examples), nova-integration-checklist.csv (initial checklist).
Calendly for workshop: https://calendly.com/redwood/novaretail-tech-workshop
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/NOVA-2026-78

If I missed anything, flag it — otherwise we’ll plan to align Ben’s cost estimate and lock a workshop slot.

Thanks,

- On the hybrid rerank, the thing we want to avoid is an extra network hop that adds latency. Can you outline the latency profile for the local filter + Redwood final rank (ballpark ms for typical 8–16 candidate lists)?
- For VPC/private deployment: procurement needs an initial compliance checklist (SOC2, audit logs, KMS). Can you confirm which of those are available in the Private offering and any gaps?

We’ve looped in our infra lead Samir on the mail — Samir, could you confirm whether the proposed workshop next Tue/Wed works?

Quick thanks — we’ll review the attachments and come back with a prioritized list of technical questions.
